À noite fui ao mercado, depois almocei, de manhã vi um filme.
De manhã vou ao mercado, depois almoço, à noite vejo um filme.
De manhã ia ao mercado, depois almoçava, à noite via um filme.

answers: Depois almocei com os meus pais.
legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the sequencer: '___ almocei com os meus pais.' (then)
legacyExercises.explanation: Depois almocei com os meus pais — depois links the next event in the chain.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which word means 'then / afterwards'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Depois — then/afterwards. Antes is before, agora is now, já is already.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: In the evening we watched a film.
legacyExercises.explanation: À noite, vimos um filme — time marker first, then the perfeito.

answers: Foi um fim de semana fixe!
Foi um fim de semana fixe.
legacyExercises.prompt: Say: It was a great weekend!
legacyExercises.explanation: Foi um fim de semana fixe! — foi is the perfeito of ser; fixe is the very Portuguese 'cool/great'.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: No sábado de manhã ___ ao mercado. (I went)
legacyExercises.explanation: Fui — the perfeito of ir for eu. 'No sábado vou' would mean next Saturday.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read the weekend report. Where did he have lunch on Saturday?
legacyExercises.explanation: At his parents' house — 'almocei com os meus pais em casa deles'.
legacyExercises.passage: O meu fim de semana foi ótimo. No sábado de manhã fui ao mercado e comprei fruta. Depois almocei com os meus pais em casa deles. À tarde, estive a ler no jardim. À noite, saí com amigos e vimos um filme. No domingo descansei.
legacyExercises.translation: My weekend was great. On Saturday morning I went to the market and bought fruit. Then I had lunch with my parents at their house. In the afternoon I was reading in the garden. In the evening I went out with friends and we watched a film. On Sunday I rested.

lessons.culturalNote: Segunda-feira de manhã, a pergunta é sempre a mesma: 'Então, como foi o fim de semana?' Have your story ready — Portuguese small talk runs on weekend reports.

lessons.title: Ir + infinitivo
lessons.objective: Use ir + infinitivo for near-future plans: vou fazer, vais sair, vamos viajar.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which says 'I'm going to make dinner'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Vou fazer o jantar — vou + infinitivo is the future. Faço is present, fiz is past, and 'vou a fazer' mixes the future with the progressive.

legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the form: we are going to travel in August — '___ viajar em agosto.'
legacyExercises.explanation: Vamos viajar em agosto — the nós form of ir is vamos, then the infinitivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which is NOT a future with ir + infinitivo?
legacyExercises.explanation: Estou a ir — that is the present progressive (I am going, right now), not a future plan. The other three are all ir + infinitivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: Are you going out tonight?
legacyExercises.explanation: Vais sair hoje à noite? — vais + infinitivo, time phrase at the end.

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: We're going to travel in August.
legacyExercises.explanation: Vamos viajar em agosto — vamos + infinitivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: Eles ___ chegar amanhã. (are going to)
legacyExercises.explanation: Vão — the eles form of ir: eles vão chegar.

answers: Friday at six in the morning.
On Friday at six in the morning.
Na sexta-feira às seis da manhã.
legacyExercises.prompt: Read about Marta's trip. When does she leave home?
legacyExercises.explanation: Friday at six in the morning — 'vai sair de casa às seis da manhã' na sexta-feira.
legacyExercises.passage: A Marta vai viajar em julho. Vai fazer as malas na sexta-feira e vai sair de casa às seis da manhã. O irmão vai levá-la ao aeroporto. Vão passar duas semanas no Algarve.
legacyExercises.translation: Marta is going to travel in July. She is going to pack on Friday and leave home at six in the morning. Her brother is going to take her to the airport. They are going to spend two weeks in the Algarve.

lessons.culturalNote: Vou fazer isto, vou fazer aquilo — the Portuguese day runs on ir + infinitivo. It is the everyday future: friendly, concrete, and far more common in speech than the futuro simples.

lessons.title: O futuro simples
lessons.objective: Form the futuro simples: falarei, choverá, serei — for promises and predictions.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which is a promise about the future?
legacyExercises.explanation: Serei pontual, prometo — serei is the future of ser. Fui is past, sou is present, era is imperfeito.

legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the future: eu falar — 'Amanhã ___ com o chefe.'
legacyExercises.explanation: Falarei — infinitivo falar + -ei ending: falarei.

legacyExercises.prompt: Falei vs falarei — which one is the future?
legacyExercises.explanation: Falarei — the extra syllable and accent mark the future. Falei is the pretérito perfeito (past), falava the imperfeito, falo the present.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: It will rain all day tomorrow.
legacyExercises.explanation: Amanhã choverá o dia todo — time first, then the future verb.

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: I will help with the suitcases.
legacyExercises.explanation: Ajudarei com as malas — ajudar + -ei.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: ___ pontual, prometo. (I will be)
legacyExercises.explanation: Serei — the future of ser for eu. Promises love the futuro simples.

answers: He will study for the exam.
legacyExercises.prompt: Read João's promises. What will he do in the afternoon?
legacyExercises.explanation: He will study for the exam — 'à tarde estudarei para o exame'.
legacyExercises.passage: O João prometeu: «Amanhã acordarei cedo e farei o pequeno-almoço. Depois irei ao banco e à tarde estudarei para o exame. À noite descansarei.»
legacyExercises.translation: João promised: 'Tomorrow I will wake up early and make breakfast. Then I will go to the bank and in the afternoon I will study for the exam. In the evening I will rest.'

lessons.culturalNote: The futuro simples sounds a little formal, a little solemn — perfect for promises (Prometo que serei pontual) and weather forecasts (Amanhã choverá). Use it and you sound deliberate.

lessons.title: Planos e intenções
lessons.objective: Express intentions with tencionar, pensar em and decidir + infinitivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which expresses an intention (not a completed change)?
legacyExercises.explanation: Tenciono mudar de emprego — tenciono = I intend. Mudei is already done (past), mudo is present habit, mudava is past habit.

answers: Penso em viajar para o Brasil.
legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the verb: '___ em viajar para o Brasil.' (I'm thinking of)
legacyExercises.explanation: Penso em viajar — pensar em + infinitivo expresses a considered idea.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which word means 'to intend'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Tencionar — to intend. Tentar is to try, ter is to have, tomar is to take.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: I decided to learn Italian.
legacyExercises.explanation: Decidi aprender italiano — decidir + infinitivo, no preposition in between.

answers: Tenciono mudar de emprego este ano.
legacyExercises.prompt: Say: I intend to change jobs this year.
legacyExercises.explanation: Tenciono mudar de emprego este ano — tenciono + plain infinitivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: Vou atualizar o ___ amanhã. (CV)
legacyExercises.explanation: Currículo — o currículo, the CV. A concrete first step for any career plan.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read about Inês's plans. What did she decide to do this week?
legacyExercises.explanation: Update her CV — 'Decidiu atualizar o currículo esta semana'.
legacyExercises.passage: A Inês tem planos grandes. Tenciona mudar de emprego este ano e pensa em fazer um curso de informática. Decidiu atualizar o currículo esta semana e vai enviar candidaturas em março.
legacyExercises.translation: Inês has big plans. She intends to change jobs this year and is thinking of doing a computing course. She decided to update her CV this week and is going to send applications in March.

lessons.culturalNote: Tenciono… is deliciously Portuguese — a soft, deliberate 'I intend to' that makes plans sound considered rather than impulsive. It is the verb of New Year's resolutions and career moves.

lessons.title: O condicional
lessons.objective: Form the condicional for 'would': falaria, poderia, seria — polite requests and hypotheticals.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which is the softest, most polite request?
legacyExercises.explanation: Poderia ajudar-me? — the condicional (would be able) is the politest form. Podes is direct, ajuda-me is a command, and vou ajudar-te offers help rather than asking.

legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the form: '___ ótimo ver-te amanhã.' (it would be great)
legacyExercises.explanation: Seria ótimo — the condicional of ser: seria.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which verb form means 'would speak'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Falaria — infinitivo + -ia = would. Falava is the imperfeito (used to speak), falou is past (spoke), falará is future (will speak).

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: You should rest more.
legacyExercises.explanation: Deverias descansar mais — dever in the condicional + infinitivo gives 'should'.

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: It would be great to see you tomorrow.
legacyExercises.explanation: Seria ótimo ver-te amanhã — seria + infinitivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: ___ ajudar-me, por favor? (could you)
legacyExercises.explanation: Poderia — the condicional of poder, the politest way to ask.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read Rui's request. What does he offer in return?
legacyExercises.explanation: Help with the shopping — 'Eu ajudaria com as compras em troca.'
legacyExercises.passage: O Rui queria pedir um favor ao vizinho. «Poderia ajudar-me a mudar o sofá no sábado? Seria ótimo. Eu ajudaria com as compras em troca.» O vizinho respondeu: «Claro, sem problema!»
legacyExercises.translation: Rui wanted to ask his neighbour a favour. 'Could you help me move the sofa on Saturday? That would be great. I would help with the shopping in return.' The neighbour answered: 'Of course, no problem!'

lessons.culturalNote: Poderia ajudar-me? opens doors in Portugal. The condicional is the politeness engine — it turns demands into gentle hypotheticals, and the Portuguese use it constantly.

lessons.title: Gostaria e queria
lessons.objective: Soften wants with gostaria de and queria + infinitivo: Queria um café, por favor.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which is the softest way to order a coffee?
legacyExercises.explanation: Queria um café, por favor — queria (imperfect of querer) is the polite 'would like'. Quero is blunt, dá-me is a command, and a bare 'Um café!' is just pointing with words.

legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the form: '___ de reservar uma mesa.' (I would like)
legacyExercises.explanation: Gostaria de reservar uma mesa — gostaria de + infinitivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: After 'gostaria de', what follows?
legacyExercises.explanation: The infinitivo: gostaria de reservar. Never a conjugated verb, never a gerund — de + infinitivo, always.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: I'd like the bill, please.
legacyExercises.explanation: Queria a conta, por favor — queria + noun works too, not just verbs.

answers: Queríamos reservar uma mesa para dois.
legacyExercises.prompt: Say: We'd like to book a table for two.
legacyExercises.explanation: Queríamos reservar uma mesa para dois — the nós form: queríamos.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: ___ de falar com o gerente. (I would like)
legacyExercises.explanation: Gostaria — gostaria de + infinitivo: gostaria de falar.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read Mr Silva's restaurant visit. What did he ask for first?
legacyExercises.explanation: A table for two — 'Queria uma mesa para dois, por favor.'
legacyExercises.passage: No restaurante, o senhor Silva chamou o empregado: «Queria uma mesa para dois, por favor.» Depois pediu: «Gostaria de ver a ementa.» No fim, disse: «Queria a conta, por favor.»
legacyExercises.translation: At the restaurant, Mr Silva called the waiter: 'I'd like a table for two, please.' Then he asked: 'I'd like to see the menu.' At the end he said: 'I'd like the bill, please.'

lessons.culturalNote: In a Portuguese café or hotel, nobody says 'Quero!' like placing an order at a counter back home. Queria um café, por favor — the imperfeito of querer — is the music of polite Portugal.

lessons.title: O conjuntivo: quero que…
lessons.objective: Trigger the present conjuntivo after quero que, é preciso que, espero que: que fales, que venhas.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which is correct after 'quero que'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Quero que fales mais devagar — the conjuntivo flips falas to fales. 'Quero que falas' uses the indicative and is wrong; falar and falava don't belong here at all.

answers: É preciso que estudes para o exame.
legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the form: 'É preciso que ___ para o exame.' (you study)
legacyExercises.explanation: É preciso que estudes — -ar verbs flip -a- to -e- in the conjuntivo: estudes.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which phrase triggers the conjuntivo?
legacyExercises.explanation: Quero que — wishing triggers the conjuntivo. Acho que, sei que and vejo que state facts, so they keep the indicative.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: I hope you come tomorrow.
legacyExercises.explanation: Espero que venhas amanhã — espero que + conjuntivo (vir → venhas).

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: I want you to be careful.
legacyExercises.explanation: Quero que tenhas cuidado — ter → tenhas in the conjuntivo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: Quero que ___ mais devagar. (you speak)
legacyExercises.explanation: Fales — the conjuntivo of falar for tu: fales.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read the mother's instructions. What time must he be home?
legacyExercises.explanation: At ten — 'é preciso que chegues a casa às dez'.
legacyExercises.passage: A mãe disse ao filho: «Quero que estudes para o exame e é preciso que chegues a casa às dez. Espero que tenhas cuidado na festa.»
legacyExercises.translation: The mother said to her son: 'I want you to study for the exam and you need to be home by ten. I hope you are careful at the party.'

lessons.culturalNote: Quero que sejas feliz — I want you to be happy. The conjuntivo is the mood of wishes, hopes and needs, and it colours the most heartfelt Portuguese sentences.

lessons.title: Que, quem, onde
lessons.objective: Join clauses with relative pronouns: o livro que comprei, com quem falei, onde nasci.

answers: A casa onde nasci é pequena.
legacyExercises.prompt: Which joins correctly? 'A casa ___ nasci é pequena.'
legacyExercises.explanation: Onde — places take onde. Que would need a preposition ('em que'), and quem is for people.
options: A casa onde nasci é pequena.
A casa que nasci é pequena.
A casa quem nasci é pequena.
A casa com nasci é pequena.

answers: O livro que comprei é ótimo.
legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the joiner: 'O livro ___ comprei é ótimo.'
legacyExercises.explanation: Que — for a thing as the object, plain que does the job.

legacyExercises.prompt: After a preposition + person, we use…
legacyExercises.explanation: Com quem — preposition + quem for people: a pessoa com quem falei. Never 'com que' for a person.

answers: A casa onde nasci é pequena.
legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: The house where I was born is small.
legacyExercises.explanation: A casa onde nasci é pequena — noun, onde-clause, then the main verb.

answers: A pessoa com quem falei foi simpática.
legacyExercises.prompt: Say: The person I spoke to was nice.
legacyExercises.explanation: A pessoa com quem falei foi simpática — person after preposition: com quem.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: O café ___ almoçamos é fixe. (where)
legacyExercises.explanation: Onde — a place takes onde.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read the restaurant review. What was delicious?
legacyExercises.explanation: The dessert — 'a sobremesa que pedimos estava deliciosa'.
legacyExercises.passage: O restaurante onde jantámos ontem é novo. O empregado com quem falámos foi muito simpático e a sobremesa que pedimos estava deliciosa.
legacyExercises.translation: The restaurant where we had dinner yesterday is new. The waiter we spoke to was very nice and the dessert we ordered was delicious.

lessons.culturalNote: A casa onde nasci, a rua onde brinquei — Portuguese identity is tied to places, and onde ties the sentences that say so.

lessons.title: Comparativos
lessons.objective: Compare with mais/menos… do que, tão… como, and the irregulars melhor, pior, maior, menor.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which is correct? 'Este café é ___ do que o outro.'
legacyExercises.explanation: Melhor — bom becomes melhor, and it never takes mais. 'Mais melhor' and 'mais bom' do not exist.

answers: O Porto é mais pequeno do que Lisboa.
legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the frame: 'O Porto é mais pequeno ___ Lisboa.'
legacyExercises.explanation: Do que — mais… do que is the full frame for 'than'.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which means 'as tall as'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Tão alta como — tão… como is the 'as… as' frame. Mais/menos… do que compare unequal things.

answers: Ela é tão alta como a irmã.
legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: She is as tall as her sister.
legacyExercises.explanation: Ela é tão alta como a irmã — the tão… como frame wraps the adjective.

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: Traffic is worse today.
legacyExercises.explanation: Hoje o trânsito está pior — mau becomes pior; estar for a temporary state.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: Este café é ___ do que o outro. (better)
legacyExercises.explanation: Melhor — the irregular comparative of bom.

answers: It's cheaper and the service is better.
It is cheaper and the service is better.
É mais barato e o atendimento é melhor.
legacyExercises.prompt: Read the café debate. Why does Ana prefer the Central?
legacyExercises.explanation: It's cheaper and the service is better — 'é mais barato do que o café Roma e o atendimento é melhor'.
legacyExercises.passage: A Ana prefere o café Central: é mais barato do que o café Roma e o atendimento é melhor. A irmã diz que o Roma é tão acolhedor como o Central, mas a Ana não concorda.
legacyExercises.translation: Ana prefers the Café Central: it is cheaper than the Café Roma and the service is better. Her sister says the Roma is as cosy as the Central, but Ana disagrees.

lessons.culturalNote: Este café é melhor do que o outro — comparisons fuel friendly Portuguese debate, from football clubs to pastéis de nata.

lessons.title: Lhe e lhes
lessons.objective: Use indirect object pronouns: dei-lhe, disse-lhes, não lhe disse nada.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which means 'I gave her the book'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Dei-lhe o livro — lhe is the indirect object pronoun (to her). 'Dei ela' is wrong, and 'dei para ela' misses the natural habit.

legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the pronoun: 'Emprestei-___ o meu carro.' (to him)
legacyExercises.explanation: Emprestei-lhe o meu carro — -lhe attaches with a hyphen: to him/her.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which sentence places the pronoun correctly after 'não'?
legacyExercises.explanation: Não lhe disse nada — after não the pronoun goes before the verb. 'Não disse-lhe' breaks the rule.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: I phoned them on Sunday.
legacyExercises.explanation: Telefonei-lhes no domingo — verb with attached pronoun first, then the time phrase.

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: I didn't tell him anything.
legacyExercises.explanation: Não lhe disse nada — não pulls the pronoun before the verb.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: Disse-___ a verdade. (to her)
legacyExercises.explanation: Lhe — disse-lhe: told her.

answers: That she made a cake and invited them for tea.
legacyExercises.prompt: Read about the grandmother. What did she tell the grandchildren?
legacyExercises.explanation: That she made a cake — 'Disse-lhes que fez um bolo'.
legacyExercises.passage: A avó telefonou aos netos no domingo. Disse-lhes que fez um bolo e convidou-os para o lanche. Eles ficaram contentes e prometeram: «Vamos ajudar-te com as compras!»
legacyExercises.translation: The grandmother phoned her grandchildren on Sunday. She told them she made a cake and invited them for tea. They were delighted and promised: 'We'll help you with the shopping!'

lessons.culturalNote: Dei-lhe os parabéns — I congratulated him/her. Lhe and lhes oil the wheels of Portuguese courtesy: giving, telling, lending, thanking.

lessons.title: Comigo, contigo, para mim
lessons.objective: Use pronouns after prepositions: para mim/ti, comigo, contigo, consigo.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which is correct? 'Vens ___ ao cinema?'
legacyExercises.explanation: Comigo — com + mim fuses into comigo. 'Com eu' is never correct, and para mim means 'for me', not 'with me'.

legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the form: 'Este café é ___ .' (for me)
legacyExercises.explanation: Para mim — after para, eu becomes mim.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which pair is correct after a preposition?
legacyExercises.explanation: Para ti — prepositions take mim/ti, never eu/tu. 'Para tu' is the giveaway error.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: I want to talk to you later.
legacyExercises.explanation: Quero falar contigo depois — falar contigo, then the time word.

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: This present is for you.
legacyExercises.explanation: Este presente é para ti — para + ti.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: Vens ___ ao cinema? (with me)
legacyExercises.explanation: Comigo — the fused form of com + mim.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read Joana's invitation. How many tickets does she have?
legacyExercises.explanation: Two — 'Tenho dois bilhetes — um é para mim e o outro é para ti.'
legacyExercises.passage: A Joana convidou o Pedro: «Vens comigo ao concerto no sábado? Tenho dois bilhetes — um é para mim e o outro é para ti.» O Pedro respondeu: «Claro! Quero falar contigo sobre a banda.»
legacyExercises.translation: Joana invited Pedro: 'Are you coming with me to the concert on Saturday? I have two tickets — one is for me and the other is for you.' Pedro answered: 'Of course! I want to talk to you about the band.'

lessons.culturalNote: Vens comigo? — Are you coming with me? These fused forms are pure everyday Portuguese: invitations, offers, and plans all run through comigo and contigo.

lessons.title: Superlativos no trabalho
lessons.objective: Use superlatives — o mais… de, -íssimo — with work and technology vocabulary.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which one is a superlative ('the oldest')?
legacyExercises.explanation: O mais antigo da cidade — the article o + mais makes it 'the oldest'. 'Mais antigo' alone is just comparative (older).

answers: Ela é a funcionária mais pontual.
legacyExercises.prompt: Predict the form: 'Ela é a funcionária mais ___ .' (punctual)
legacyExercises.explanation: A funcionária mais pontual — feminine article a with the feminine noun.

legacyExercises.prompt: Rapidíssimo means…
legacyExercises.explanation: Super fast — -íssimo is the absolute superlative: extremely, really. Not just 'fast' and not a comparison.

legacyExercises.prompt: Put the words in order: We have a meeting at nine.
legacyExercises.explanation: Temos uma reunião às nove — ter + noun is the habit for 'have a meeting'.

legacyExercises.prompt: Say: My boss is really great.
legacyExercises.explanation: O meu chefe é fixíssimo — or 'A minha chefe é fixíssima' for a female boss.

legacyExercises.prompt: Fill the gap: O computador novo é ___ . (super fast)
legacyExercises.explanation: Rapidíssimo — the -íssimo absolute superlative of rápido.

legacyExercises.prompt: Read about Sofia's new job. What time was the first meeting?
legacyExercises.explanation: At nine — 'A primeira reunião foi às nove'.
legacyExercises.passage: A Sofia começou um trabalho novo. O escritório é o mais moderno da empresa e os colegas são simpaticíssimos. A primeira reunião foi às nove e a chefe explicou tudo com calma.
legacyExercises.translation: Sofia started a new job. The office is the most modern in the company and her colleagues are super nice. The first meeting was at nine and her boss explained everything calmly.

lessons.culturalNote: O meu chefe é fixíssimo — my boss is the best. The -íssimo superlative is everyday Portuguese enthusiasm, from rapidíssimo wifi to a caríssimo lunch.

lessons.title: Missão: no hotel
lessons.objective: Check into a hotel in Porto: the reservation, the key, breakfast time.

lessons.title: Revisão: o essencial do A1
lessons.objective: Review A1 end to end: greet, order, chat about yesterday and tomorrow, leave warmly.
